## Execution checkpoint — whole roadmap remains in progress

All **20 issues, 80 acceptance criteria, 41 native dependency links and 5 milestones** remain in scope. Dates and assignees remain unset. Six issues (#2, #3, #5, #6, #8, #11) have historical local acceptance; the remaining fourteen are **not accepted**. Draft PR #22 and the previously recorded commit are not current CI, publication, deployment or merge-ready evidence.

### Native DSH
- DESIGN repair3/3 now has both complete independent original and quality reviews: **SHIP for the bounded static proposal only**, zero CRITICAL/HIGH. Reports identify exact reviewed content digest `498ca1fa848739d0e32211b3b45cc578e4288e3668494671fa9125d976be3586`; each reviewer reported its own passing documentary checks. Both complete report intakes and actual native Done → release → delivery acknowledgement lifecycles were observed.
- Original live-runtime criteria remain `BLOCKED_NOTRUN`; **0/14 carrier families are runtime-qualified**. The old stock startup failure does not establish global completion or its lost raw cause; there is no third stock bootstrap.
- The actual owner has now authorized **gated implementation**: complete pinned SDK/build/export/generated/license closure inventory, independent execution-contract review, then worker-owned code only within approved groups (hard 25 files/2,000 true inserted lines per group, including full copied/generated closure). The new read-only inventory worker has received its whole-method first-access grant. Principal issuance, credential custody, spend, native activation and actual runtime acceptance retain separate gates; no paid calls were authorized.

### Investigation read model
- The same fifth prospective cycle has one immutable candidate: SHA256 `814f7a95b27865f658522b394b960157852e00fd814746e65ef52356331157d7`, **318,376 bytes**. Complete opaque transport, all three whole future-program identities and the actual canonical diff were mechanically checked: **1,106 true insertions, 37 deletions, 1,069 net**, not a net-as-size shortcut. Complete bounded lossless fixture identities and unchanged input guards were checked; this is not code semantic approval or executed behavior.
- The original full-scope reviewer has received its complete before-access grant. The initial quality attempt explicitly failed **before artifact access**, producing neither semantic review nor report; the author also explicitly ended with a failed preparation-only handoff. Both actual failure settlements were released after Done and before acknowledgement. These are not feature acceptance or completed review-pair evidence.
- The actual owner authorized recovery of the **same failed quality task**, with a fresh full before-access method. Only if both complete independent reviews pass may workers apply that exact candidate and perform separately qualified changed-path smoke. No sixth repair cycle, new candidate, native activation, paid execution or original feature waiver was granted.

The coordinator remains outside production/test/SDK/source code and delegates implementation and semantic review through native workers. Product model generation calls remain **0**. The shared product allowance remains **USD 20: DSH 12 / Brain 8**; coding, storage and all-in costs are **unknown**, not measured zero. The original full native persistence/restart, read-model/Scene, assistant, atlas, publication, replay, collection, governance and CI acceptance gates remain required before roadmap completion.
